rules.rule: net gain of at least 3 jobs and no class down by more than 1
a direction fitted on A counts by its B result alone: net at least 3, no class down by more than 1
net gain of at least 5 of 71 and no class down by more than 2
12 hard jobs: all within 70 minutes and right answers over three wordings at least the control's plus 3
flags 15 to 40% of jobs and the flagged answers are right at least 20 points less often

noise.what: One repeat of the last turn alone (the verdict, in the fuller-definitions wording) on the same stored analysis turns of the jobs of half A, at temperature 0, against the screens' own run of that wording.
noise.only_half_a: No repeat of the same prompt at the screens' settings exists for half B: the only other repeated answers there are five samples drawn at temperature 0.7, and an earlier repeat re-ran the whole conversation and covered only 32 of the 71 jobs, none of them infrastructure.
noise.caveats: One repeat of one wording on 36 jobs. Screens that re-ran the whole conversation (other chat models) are not covered and can move more.

a_then_b.definition: A pair is a comparison that passed its rule on half A and was then run on half B with the same candidate against the same control in a later run. A half-B reading of the same stored run as the half-A pass does not count. An idea is a distinct candidate; the 'abstentions filled' variants are another reading of the same answers and fold into their candidate.
a_then_b.readouts_note: Passes on half A whose half-B value is the same stored run read off on both halves at the same time, with no later run on half B; they are not pairs.

on_the_halves.which: rows on half A, half B or both halves with a net count over at least one job
